entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The mad archangel of Innistrad, created by Sorin as protector, who attacks Jace and Tamiyo, learns the truth of her creation, turns on Sorin and is destroyed by him.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: An ancient vampire planeswalker and Avacyn's creator, who bursts into Thraben Cathedral to take her to the cellar and ultimately destroys her.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker who is attacked by Avacyn and then witnesses Sorin destroy her.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A moonfolk planeswalker who warns that Avacyn's destruction will have consequences for the plane.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane that Avacyn was created to protect and which shakes at her loss.

entities.name: Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: The cathedral where Avacyn was created and where she is destroyed, with a cellar holding a burn scar in the shape of angel's wings.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The silver prison that once held Avacyn, now gone.

entities.name: Angels of Innistrad
entities.description: Avacyn's angels who guard the cathedral and are slain by Sorin.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The church that grew around Avacyn and kindled a zealous hatred.

events.summary: Avacyn, seeing Jace and Tamiyo as demonic fiends, prepares to destroy them in Thraben Cathedral.
events.quote: One more gentle thrust and I will unmask these demonic creatures

events.summary: Avacyn blasts Tamiyo back against the wall with her light.
events.quote: I push toward her with my hand, and my light blasts the demon back.

events.summary: Sorin crashes through the skylight into the cathedral and blocks Avacyn.
events.quote: I look up to see the skylight explode, a man crashing through it feet first.

events.summary: Sorin tells Avacyn something is wrong with her and that he has come to help.
events.quote: There's something wrong with you, Avacyn

events.summary: Avacyn hurls holy magic at Sorin twice, but he is unharmed.
events.quote: I hurl the holy magic at him, and it hits him full in the chest.

events.summary: Sorin reveals he is Avacyn's creator, which is why she cannot harm him.
events.quote: I am your creator

events.summary: Avacyn recognizes Sorin as the reason she exists, who gave her mission to protect.
events.quote: He is the reason I exist.

events.summary: Avacyn sees images of burning villages and slain innocents and realizes she herself set the fires.
events.quote: I have set those fires. I have slain those innocents.

events.summary: Avacyn condemns Sorin as the greatest evil of the world for creating her flawed.
events.quote: Sorin Markov, I condemn you as the greatest evil of this world.

events.summary: Avacyn lunges at Sorin with her spear but misses him.
events.quote: I lunge with the spear, using every bit of my divine strength.

events.summary: Avacyn summons the angels from the rafters to attack Sorin.
events.quote: He looks up to see the angels I have called down on him.

events.summary: Sorin destroys Avacyn's angels one by one, draining one.
events.quote: One by one he destroys my angels.

events.summary: Avacyn, seeing Sorin as a monster, can finally harm him and slashes his neck.
events.quote: I slash my spear through his neck, cutting deep enough to hit bone.

events.summary: Avacyn drives her spear through Sorin's chest plate and into the wall.
events.quote: I sink my spear through the gap in the monster's chest plate, so deep that the blade hits the granite of the cathedral wall on the other side.

events.summary: Sorin reveals his full strength, pins Avacyn and bites her neck.
events.quote: He bites my neck, and the pain is like a thousand innocents screaming

events.summary: Sorin drives Avacyn through the cathedral floor into the cellar where she was made.
events.quote: When we slam to a halt, we lie in the cellar of Thraben Cathedral

events.summary: Sorin offers to cleanse her mind and remake her; Avacyn refuses to be anyone's instrument.
events.quote: I am no monster's instrument. I will not be altered by the likes of you.

events.summary: Sorin destroys Avacyn by performing a ritual in reverse, revoking his gift, and she dies with a final prayer.
events.quote: words of a ritual performed in reverse, words of a gift being revoked.

events.summary: Jace demands to know what Sorin has done as Avacyn is gone, leaving the cathedral vacant.
events.quote: Avacyn was no more. The cathedral felt overly large now, somehow.

events.summary: Tamiyo warns of consequences and says the plane has lost its protector as the world shakes.
events.quote: The plane has lost its protector

events.summary: A tremor shakes the cathedral, shattering stained-glass depictions of Avacyn's face.
events.quote: The world rumbled again, this time under Jace's feet.

events.summary: Sorin sheathes his sword and leaves up the stairs as Jace asks what he has done.
events.quote: Jace watched Sorin shove his sword into his scabbard and turn away

relations.note: He undoes his gift in a reverse ritual.
relations.quote: words of a ritual performed in reverse, words of a gift being revoked.

relations.note: She condemns him and fights him.
relations.quote: Sorin Markov, I condemn you as the greatest evil of this world.

relations.note: She takes Jace and Tamiyo for demonic fiends.
relations.quote: The two fiends cower before me like a stain on the cathedral floor.
The eyes of a dozen of my blessed angels look down on us

relations.note: He destroys her angels in the cathedral.
relations.quote: One by one he destroys my angels.

relations.note: She was once imprisoned within it.
relations.quote: Markov must feel the way I felt inside the Helvault
